A note found in the front of the book.

The printer left this page without a heading.

Book I

The Voyage

CHAPTER I.

The night was clear, and the harbour was full of lamps.
Chapter 3 was the best part of the
book according to the reviewer.

CHAPTER II.

They sailed at dawn without a speech.

CHAPTER III.

The island had no name on the chart.

CHAPTER IV.

A storm took the mast and spared the cook.

CHAPTER V.

Land, when it came, was only a line.

Book II

The Return

CHAPTER I.

The same harbour looked smaller.

CHAPTER II.

He did not tell the story twice.
